description: Pre-fab checker: schematic/PCB agreement, BOM sanity and part risk before you order.
description_full: KiCad Preflight checks a KiCad project before you export Gerbers and order: schematic-to-PCB agreement (missing or mismatched footprints, stray parts, duplicate references), BOM sanity (unknown references, quantity mismatches, missing or placeholder manufacturer part numbers, DNP mistakes), and offline part-risk flags (obsolete, low stock, long lead time) from an honestly labelled sample dataset. When kicad-cli is installed it also folds in the official DRC/ERC results. Deterministic rules only - no LLM decides the verdict - and every finding names the exact part and values that disagree. Also usable as a standalone CLI, including on BOM CSVs exported from any EDA tool.
name: KiCad Preflight
